query.commandtext: SELECT * FROM TQD_UPDATELOG WHERE FACILITY = :facility AND START_TIME = :start_time
INSERT INTO TQD_UPDATELOG (FACILITY , EQUIP_ID , START_TIME) VALUES(:facility,:equip_id,TO_DATE(:start_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))

UPDATE TQD_UPDATELOG SET END_TIME = TO_DATE(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ,SVC_TIME = TO_DATE(:svc_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ,TR_TYPE = :tr_type ,SUCCESS_FLAG =:success_flag ,STEP_SEQ = :step_seq ,RESULT_FILE = :result_file ,ERROR_FILE =:error_file ,BACKUP_FILE =:backup_file ,DEFECTS = :defects ,IMAGES =:images WHERE EQUIP_ID = :equip_id AND START_TIME = TO_DATE(:start_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

query.description: 장비와 기간을 조건으로 Update History를 가져온다
query.commandtext: SELECT FACILITY AS FAB ,EQUIP_ID AS EQUIP ,TO_CHAR(START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS START_TIME ,TO_CHAR(END_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS END_TIME ,TO_CHAR(SVC_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SERVICE_TIME ,TR_TYPE AS TRANS_TYPE ,SUCCESS_FLAG ,STEP_SEQ ,RESULT_FILE AS RESULT ,ERROR_FILE AS ERROR ,BACKUP_FILE AS BACKUP ,DEFECTS ,IMAGES FROM TQD_UPDATELOG WHERE START_TIME BETWEEN :fromtime AND :totime AND EQUIP_ID = :equip_id ORDER BY START_TIME DESC

SELECT SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),1,13) AS HO,COUNT(*) AS COUNT,SUM(DEFECTS) FROM TQD_UPDATELOG WHERE EQUIP_ID = :equip_id AND START_TIME BETWEEN :fromtime AND :totime GROUP BY SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),1,13)

SELECT SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),1,13) AS HO,COUNT(*) AS COUNT,SUM(DEFECTS) FROM TQD_UPDATELOG WHERE START_TIME BETWEEN :fromtime AND :totime GROUP BY SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),1,13)
